name: Lord Summerset
source:
One of the 7 dukes/duchesses of the Kortian Empire, Lord Summerset is known for being the fairest and kindness of all the lords. He is the father of Alexis, and a friend to many, however, he is unmarried. His land is known for its prosperous fields and its friendly people.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
